record.field: Inventory, traceability, pricelists, Point of Sale
Put the donated objects for sale, open the till with a social pricelist… and find a chest of drawers that vanished.

field.name: description
field.p: La Ressourcerie collects donated objects, repairs them and sells them at low prices in its charity shop. Help its volunteers run their stock and their till with Odoo… and track down a chest of drawers that has gone missing.

div.p: Functional challenge: not a single line of code. Everything happens in the interface of Odoo, in the Inventory and Point of Sale apps.
The names to create are in bold: accents and capital letters do not matter. Click Check whenever you like: the tab Checker Report lists what is still missing.

Create 8 articles for sale in three product categories: Clothing, Furniture and Appliances, with at least one article in each. Each article has a sales price, its stock is tracked, and it can be sold at the till.

div.h6: 2 · The social pricelist Point of Sale
div.p: People on a tight budget pay half price. Create a pricelist Social Rate which gives 50 % off, and make it available in the shop.
💡 The pricelists are an option to activate in the settings of the Point of Sale. These settings apply to a shop: create it first.
A donor who wishes to remain anonymous drops off a few objects. Record their receipt from a new contact Anonymous Donor, and validate it to bring the objects into stock.
Open a session of the till in your shop, and make three paid sales, at least one of them at the Social Rate.
💡 The Social Rate does not show up at the till? Reload the page of the till.
The shop closes: close the session of the till.

div.h6: 6 · The lost chest of drawers Inventory
div.p: Josiane Feller brought back the Art Deco chest of drawers she had bought, because a drawer was broken… and nobody has seen it since. Find it, create an internal location Repair Workshop, and move this very chest of drawers there.
💡 The shop has several identical chests of drawers: only their serial number tells them apart.
